subject: Re: MAP & POC kickoff — Acme Payments network + API access
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@acmepay.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmepay.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP kickoff — POC environment & network tasks

Hi Samira / Tom,

Thanks again for the time today — excited to get the MAP and POC moving. I attached a draft MAP (ACME_MAP_v1.1.xlsx) and a simple network diagram to show the two integration options (IP allowlist vs VPC peering). Proposed high-level timeline so we can align: 

- Week 0 (this week): Agree MAP items and owners, exchange network contacts
- Week 1: Redwood creates Acme staging org + scoped API key; Acme provides AWS account/VPC IDs and CIDR
- Week 2: Network work (allowlist or peering) + basic smoke tests
- Week 3: Sample traffic + quality review and handoff

Key MAP tasks for technical setup (please confirm owners):
1) Redwood: create customer org in staging, generate an API key scoped to inference-only and add expiry (90d) — owner: @Stephanie
2) Acme: provide AWS account ID, VPC ID, and public CIDR(s) for allowlist; share network engineer contact — owner: Acme IT
3) Both: VPC peering if you prefer private path (we'll exchange VPC IDs and route table changes) — owner: network teams
4) Acme: complete SOC2/infosec quick read (we received your SOC2_summary.pdf) and confirm additional audit artifacts needed — owner: Samira

Can you confirm preferred network approach (IP allowlist or VPC peering) and share the AWS account/VPC details? If you prefer, we can start with IP allowlist for faster time-to-first-test and follow up with peering for sustained throughput.

Proposed dates: onboarding call Tues 2026-02-03 10am PT. Does that work?

I copied Stephanie (platform ops) and Monica (solutions engineering) so they can start the staging org prep.

Best,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0163

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.1.xlsx, network_diagram_acme.pdf

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@acmepay.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmepay.com>, Acme IT <it-acme@acmepay.com>
Date: 2026-01-30T11:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — POC environment & network tasks

Hi Lauren — thanks, this looks good. Quick answers below and a couple asks from our side.

Network preference: We'd like to start with IP allowlist to get an initial test running quickly, then move to VPC peering for the production-like run.

AWS info (staging account):
- AWS account ID: 123456789012
- VPC ID: vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h
- VPC CIDR (private): 10.10.0.0/16
- Public egress CIDR we can allow temporarily: 54.204.0.0/16

Network contact: Jenna Ortiz, jenn.a.ortiz@acmepay.com (network engineering)

Security: we reviewed SOC2_summary.pdf — we will need the following additional items before peering: BCP contact, encryption in transit details, and a finalized MOU for peering.

On API keys/org: we prefer Redwood to create a customer-scoped org name "acme-payments-staging" and provide a short-lived API key with role-limited scopes.

We can do Tue 2026-02-03 10am PT for the kickoff. Looking forward to the MAP being finalized.

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships | Acme Payments
samira.k@acmepay.com

---
References: SOC2_summary.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-02T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Acme MAP — staging org + API key request

Team — per the MAP we're green to start with IP allowlist and then support a peering path. Action items I need from platform/infra: 

1) Create customer org: name "acme-payments-staging" in our staging region (us-west-2) and add Monica as initial owner so she can manage teams.
2) Generate a scoped API key: inference-only, token limits = 100k tokens/day, expires in 90 days. Please set it as "single-tenant" for now (isolated rate limits).
3) Add an allowlist entry for Acme public CIDR: 54.204.0.0/16 and any additional IPs Jenna provides.
4) Prepare VPC peering checklist: exchange VPC IDs, subnet ranges to allow route table edits, and required security groups. We'll need a short doc snippet we can send to Acme IT (I can forward once ready).

Timelines: can we have 1+2 done by EOD 2026-02-06 and item 3 done by EOD 2026-02-09? If peering is chosen after smoke tests, Karthik please estimate 3 business days for the peering coordination + routes.

Cc'ing Monica to track on the MAP.
Lauren

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-05T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Acme MAP — staging org + API key request

Lauren — noted. We'll do the following: 

- Create org: acme-payments-staging (us-west-2) and invite Monica as org admin.
- Generate scoped API key: inference-only, limited to 100k tokens/day, expires 90 days. I'll put the key in the secure key vault and provide a one-time download link to Jenna (per their network contact) and Samira.
- Allowlist: we'll apply 54.204.0.0/16 now; waiting for any additional ranges from Jenna.
- VPC peering checklist: Karthik will draft the checklist and the minimal set of routing/security group changes; we'll include example AWS CLI commands.

ETA: org + API key provisioning by 2026-02-06 EOD. Allowlist updated 2026-02-09 as requested. Karthik, please post the peering checklist here by Tue 2026-02-10 so I can forward to Acme IT.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Principal Platform Ops Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf (redacted copy for Acme)

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmepay.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.k@acmepay.com>
Cc: Jenna Ortiz <jenn.a.ortiz@acmepay.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-14T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — POC environment & network tasks

Lauren / all — quick confirmation from Acme side:

- We will proceed with the IP allowlist for the initial smoke tests. Jenna has added the Redwood requestor and will open the firewall ticket tomorrow.
- Peering: we want to schedule peering after the first week of traffic; I'll coordinate with Jenna on an MOU for peering.
- DocuSign: I've signed the MAP and sent it back (DocuSign ID: 0b3c-ACME-POC).
- Canary tests: can Redwood provide a small canary plan (3 requests per minute for 1 hour, send sample payloads) so we can validate latency and egress behavior in staging?

On the API key: once you share the one-time link to Jenna, we'll load it into our secret manager and avoid sharing it in email.

Thanks — Tues 2026-02-17 at 10am ET also works if you need a follow-up; otherwise the 2026-02-03 call you proposed earlier was a good place to start and we are aligned on dates.

Best,
Tom
Director of Platform Engineering | Acme Payments
